title: Validate request
description: A request to check whether runs would be admitted, without submitting them. Give exactly one of a run spec, a recipe name or a recipe document; a recipe is composed first and each of its runs is checked.

run_spec.description: A `run-spec/1` document, with its sensor by reference or in place.

recipe_name.description: The name of a recipe in the library (its file stem).

recipe.description: A recipe document (`compose: compose/1`), composed against the library.

compose.description: The composition rules the recipe is written for.

engine_check.description: `none`: the engine-free checks only (the run-spec schema, reference resolution, content-hash verification and the library files); pure, and needs no engine. These are the checks admission runs. `dry_run`: those checks and a DIRSIG dry run of the assembled job, which needs a local DIRSIG installation.
